use_case: Quarterly Agile Maturity Assessment and Coaching Plan Generation

agent_behavior.survey_mode: Pulls 3-5 contextual questions based on team trends and lever scores
agent_behavior.conversation_mode: Understands free-text queries from users like SMs or coaches and suggests actions
agent_behavior.coaching_mode: Auto-suggests a structured plan based on lowest scoring levers
agent_behavior.validation: Coaching plans are sent to Scrum Master and Coach for final approval

output_format.coaching_plan: Plain text or linked doc with objectives, actions, validation owner

modifiability.levers: Can be updated dynamically via config input
modifiability.frequency: Can toggle between monthly and quarterly assessment modes

scalability: Supports multiple product lines with persona-based drill downs
